answer: Duplicating identities multiplies the work linearly, so an attacker flooding N sockpuppets pays N times the energy cost while honest participants pay once, making mass fakery economically irrational. Sybil resistance here uses a per-epoch proof-of-work tied to a unique identity kernel: each agent must burn compute to derive a nonce whose pigment hash falls beneath a difficulty ridge set by the previous epoch's participation. From Agent0025's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
